jobs.name: Itamar Team Maroon homework and exam reminders
jobs.prompt:
Every day at 15:45 America/New_York, use the attached LIVE Google Slides export of Team Maroon Homework Calendar (2026–2027) and the LOCAL DATE printed by the script. This is Itamar's homework monitor. He has BOTH Language Arts teachers (Snyder and Lyons) AND BOTH Math teachers (Lydon and Argerakis), so include actionable homework from each, labeled by teacher, as well as Science and Social Studies. Read the slide headed by TODAY's weekday, month and day (not yesterday's slide); report every real actionable item including reading and study notes, with explicitly stated due dates. Ignore blanks, 'none', 'No HW', stale dated Barran boilerplate, and month grids as daily assignments. The Math (Argerakis) row contains a 'Click here' link to an external Algebra 7 Assignment Calendar: https://www.commonplanner.com/sites/my-fantastic-website-url-6a930ae5988be14c33000362 . ALWAYS use browser_exec to open this planner, wait for load, extract document.body.innerText and read TODAY's day section (and any due-date notices) before deciding whether there is homework. It is a weekly planner with adjacent day sections: do not assign a previous or next day's work to today, and don't treat lesson headings alone as homework. If this planner is inaccessible, do not claim no Math (Argerakis) homework; explicitly say its status could not be checked when sending a homework message, or send a short access-failure notice rather than falsely asserting none. Do not repeat stale homework from earlier slides on a blank/non-school day.
Also use family_tasks to list Itamar's open future exam/quiz/test events around today through the next 4 days, and remind EXACTLY 3 days and 1 day before each registered event, naming the exam and date. If either live source announces a new future exam with an explicit date, use family_tasks_ingest to record it for Itamar after checking duplicates; apply the same 3/1-day reminder policy. Do not invent dates for undated tests. Combine today's homework and exam reminders into one concise message. If there is neither verified actual homework nor a 3/1-day reminder, reply exactly [SILENT] (Hermes suppresses delivery). If the Google Slides fetch fails, the script raises an error; never interpret retrieval failure as no homework. Source: https://docs.google.com/presentation/d/1cY6tWnL1xU5Q6IpFL21lgPFnOhAowuYBJP_3JidTcZM/edit. Keep response in English, no tables.
